metadata.value: We created a small knowledge base in order to test the ontology. The knowledge base was populated with data from a Bach’s chorale, namely the sixth movement of the church cantata Wie schön leuchtet der Morgenstern. The piece is catalogued under the index BWV1. The sixth and last movement is the chorale entitled *"Wie bin ich doch so herzlich froh"*.
